name: Serve consistency ladder
summary: Serve into the diagonal service box and climb a ladder of consecutive serves in, from 3 to 10.
setup: Bucket of at least 20 balls at the server's baseline
Serve from the right, then the left, into the diagonal service box
Rungs: 3, 5, 7, 10 serves in a row; a fault drops you back one rung
Use the same short pre-serve routine (feet set, breath, target) before every serve
Serve as your rules allow; the serve rules are UNVERIFIED in this app
success_criterion: Reach the 10-in-a-row rung, or at most 2 faults in 20 serves
coach_rationale: (judgment) A repeatable routine and a consecutive-serve target reduce serve faults, which AN-05 counts directly; no partner needed. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
